novelty_search.nearest_screen: The design-seen affine screen matched or exceeded v10 on the old fresh population, but its predictor form was informed by that population.
novelty_search.new_question: Do the same four coefficients, fixed token IDs, and rank-one basis predict selective actuation on 16 new agents and 16 new periods whose model outcomes and target-guided alphas have never been inspected?

prospective_boundary.scope: New lexicon inside the two already tested archive/explanatory constructions; this is not unrestricted syntax OOD.

frozen_predictor.actuator: At the source state, confidence is the fixed current-tense has/had margin; alpha is the frozen direction-specific intercept plus slope times confidence; patch is x_source + alpha*q. No new-text donor activation, row outcome IDs, search, or outcome selects alpha.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_source_capabili: All hashes, zero old/new row-ID overlap, exact frozen coefficients, A base/donor capability, P source capability, C actual-task base capability, and exact-head replay pass. C has/had probe sign is not a capability condition.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_input_conditioned_actuator: All 64 alphas use only the four frozen coefficients, direction, fixed has/had IDs, and source state; no new-text donor activation, row outcome IDs, grid, or outcome participates.
predictions.pred_c_new_lexicon_A_prediction: A1 and A2 each have mean recovery >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_new_lexicon_P_generalization: P has mean margin reflection >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: All 64 rows are unique within 25 model forwards, 200 example evaluations, exactly 176 selected-head pair evaluations, zero grids/backwards/updates, and four inherited fit parameters.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: the four-parameter source-state gain predicts selective carrier actuation on genuinely new lexicon in the registered construction scope.
terminal.null: Authority, frozen actuator, and coverage pass but new-lexicon A/P prediction or C selectivity misses.
terminal.invalid: Authority, novelty, source capability, head control, frozen actuator, or coverage fails.
